pt.title: Competente o Suficiente
pt.subtitle: Um ano colocando a inteligência artificial à prova, sem medo e sem propaganda.
pt.alt: Competente o Suficiente as a 3D paperback: a giant retro-futurist robot with a weary round face kneels at a 1950s World's Fair while a crowd watches. The title runs down the navy spine.

intro: I took the year's articles from my blog, reorganized and rewrote them as one story, fact-checked them again and illustrated them. It's for anyone anxious or confused about AI: the professional afraid of being replaced, the parent who read that AGI is two years away, the manager being sold an "AI transformation".

inside.title: What's inside
inside.lede: Five parts, each answering a question people keep asking me about AI.

parts.title: What is this thing, anyway
parts.question: Is it intelligent? Is AGI coming?

parts.title: The marathon
parts.question: Does it actually work, or is it all demo?

parts.title: Numbers and propaganda
parts.question: Which AI is best? Should I believe the announcements?

parts.title: Who holds the keys
parts.question: Is it dangerous to let it touch my things?

parts.title: What about my job?
parts.question: Will it take my job? What comes next?

inside.extras: Plus two interludes, an optional appendix on how the machine works inside (no math), a timeline, practical checklists and the list of the original articles behind each chapter.

made.title: How it's made
made.lede: The book lives in an open repository, next to the tooling that keeps it in sync with my blog.
points: Every paragraph records which article it came from. When an article changes, one command shows which chapters it affects.
Diagrams are drawn as code. AI-generated illustrations are disclosed in the image credits, and real photos carry their licenses.
Every build runs a regression suite and an integrity check of cross-references, citations, figures and the English edition's parity with the Portuguese original.
